name: Han 86
apex_description: This advanced weapon system comes equipped with a specialized targeting optic and airburst launcher. The Han X20 Skybreaker dials into a precise area within range and fires a 20mm airburst shell, which detonates in the air on target with devastating results. Highly effective at flushing cover. Direct impacts will result in a dud. Blocks Optic, Stock, and Barrel Attachments.
description: Manufactured for the South Korean military, the Han 86 delivers reliable performance across a wide range of combat environments. Chambered in 5.56, the weapon’s high rate of fire and moderate damage make it a capable option for close-quarters engagements and longer-range fights.

name: M4
apex_description: A top-loading, high-capacity M4 variant chambered in 5.7x28mm. Taking inspiration from other bullpup designs, this agile rifle is light, maneuverable, and boasts a higher rate of fire. Blocks Barrel and Magazine Attachments.
description: Fully automatic and highly adaptable, this iconic service rifle excels in most combat engagements.

name: Hyeon Burst
apex_description: The Hyeon Hyperburst features an overlocked receiver that delivers a blinding-fast, three-round burst followed by slow, controlled, fully automatic fire. Deliver a burst of precision followed by sustained fire to finish off anything still standing.
description: A versatile North Korean prototype rifle running 6.8mm with a hard-hitting burst mode that puts fast, decisive rounds on target.

name: Patriot XMR
apex_description: Stun targets and clear tight quarters with shocking efficiency with the Patriot XMR Volt. This underbarrel launcher fires a wide dispersal of several 50,000V darts. Non-lethal, but powerful enough to override fine motor control and prime targets for elimination. Blocks Barrel Attachments.
description: A full-auto rifle that delivers high-impact fire with substantial recoil, the Patriot XMR rewards controlled fire, hitting hard at mid to long ranges when properly braced.

name: Kastov 762
apex_description: An experimental disruption barrel with an integrated optic. Emits a concentrated high-intensity RF pulse capable of incapacitating infantry, crippling electronics, and destabilizing vehicles caught in its crosshairs.Blocks Barrel Attachments.
description: A full-auto 7.62x39mm rifle offering heavy per-shot impact with equally firm recoil. Reliable and forceful but requires control to keep on target.

name: Oden
apex_description: Turn devasting firepower into surgical precision. This conversion transforms the weapon into a semi-automatic sniper rifle, complete with a bipod, custom suppressor, and sniper scope to dominate distant targets with every shot. Blocks Barrel and Muzzle Attachments.
description: Chambered for hard-hitting 12.7x55mm ammunition, this bullpup platform balances brutal impact with a lower cyclic rate.

name: Axion
apex_description: Built for fast-paced assaults, this conversion replaces the stock and pistol grip with a specialized chainsaw rear grip configuration. A handlebar foregrip, hip laser, and canted aiming system improve responsiveness for highly mobile, hipfire-focused gameplay. Blocks Optic, Laser, Underbarrel, Stock, and Rear Grip Attachments.
description: Built around subsonic .300 BLK rounds, the Axion is a hard-hitting rifle with a slower rate of fire that rewards accuracy with formidable stopping power at most ranges. Subsonic rounds hide enemy skulls on kills.

name: Cronen Squall
apex_description: Fire a precision-guided missile and direct its flight path while aiming down sights using an infrared targeting laser. The projectile can be fired without guidance, though effectiveness drops sharply at extended ranges. Blocks Laser and Underbarrel Attachments.
description: Chambered in 6.8 Wrath, this open-bolt, bullpup marksman rifle combines long-range accuracy and controllable recoil with punishing damage output.

name: ISO Nightshade
apex_description: Specialized RFD ammunition tags targets on impact, feeding real-time tracking data to the optic’s integrated display, which shows a red dot of the target’s movement and direction. Blocks Optic and Ammunition Attachments.
description: A full-auto 9x19mm SMG with a fast rate of fire, the ISO Nightshade balances controllability, mobility, and close-quarters stopping power into a versatile platform suited for any operator.

name: VEL 46
apex_description: Built for lightning-fast weapon transitions, this tactical sling sacrifices the ability to equip stocks for unmatched reaction speed in close-quarters fights. Allows Quick Draw when used with Overkill. Blocks Stock Attachment.
description: Chambered in 4.6x30mm, the VEL 46 excels in fast-paced combat, pairing exceptional maneuverability with smooth, predictable recoil.

name: Wz.55 Striga
apex_description: A paired-frame conversion that outfits the Wz.55 Striga for akimbo use, doubling its close-quarters output while keeping the platform’s natural agility. Control takes discipline, but its speed and volume are unmatched. Blocks Optic, Stock, and Underbarrel Attachments.
description: Fast, lethal, and easy to handle, this 9x18mm SMG delivers best-in-class mobility and recoil control with significant stopping power and a low rate of fire. Subsonic rounds hide enemy skulls on kills.

name: PPSh-41
apex_description: A unique underbarrel that launches a rapid burst of advanced pyrotechnic projectiles, laying down intense incendiary coverage that remains burning for a short time, offering area control. Blocks Barrel, Underbarrel, and Magazine Attachments.
description: A legendary submachine gun with over 80 years of combat service, the PPSh-41 overwhelms enemies at close range with its best-in-class rate of fire and generous ammo capacity.

name: X-58 Nyx
apex_description: The pinnacle of stealth warfare, this subsonic modification produces an exceptionally quiet report, hides skills on enemy deaths, and minimizes direction hit indicators to keep your attacks concealed. Blocks Barrel and Ammunition Attachments.
description: Backed by illicit funding, the unique X-58 Nyx is an advanced 5.8x21mm SMG designed for covert operations. Featuring an integrated suppressor with a titanium-core battle system, it offers superior sound reduction and dependable close-to-mid-range performance.

name: Rezi 12
apex_description: Enables pump-action cycling and is outfitted with a side-saddle for hot-loaded explosive slugs. The added capability extends the platform’s engagement envelope well beyond tradition 12-gauge roles.
description: A fast-cycling semi-auto 12-guage, the modular Rezi 12 delivers powerful, controlled shots with smooth recovery. Built for decisive close-range work.

name: Warlord
apex_description: A blinding strobe pattern that triggers immediately upon aiming down sights and impairs hostile vision. The strobe must recharge between uses. Blocks Optic and Laser Attachments.
description: A pump-action 12-gauge bruiser that feeds from dual tubes, delivering close-range firepower with every hit. The high ammo capacity makes it slow to reload.

name: FiNN LMG
apex_description: A Tempest Armament weapon modification that unthrottles the rate of fire beyond the weapon's operational abilities. Sustained fire can overheat the weapon requiring the weapon to cool down before returning to full auto fire.
description: An open-bolt, belt-fed LMG chambered in 5.56. Lightweight, mobile, and exceptionally stable, the FiNN pairs a high fire rate with advanced recoil control to provide outstanding accuracy in full-auto engagements.

name: Type 73
apex_description: A specialized weapon kit that adapts the Type 73 receiver to accept a top-mounted magazine loaded with Explosive Rounds. Limited ammo capacity is offset by the sheer, overwhelming stopping power. Blocks Magazine and Ammunition Attachments.
description: With a long service history, the Type 73 is a Korean-made LMG inspired by Soviet designs and chambered in 7.62x54r. While heavy and slower to handle, its hard-hitting rounds and sustained automatic fire make it a powerful weapon at medium and long range.

name: APOC-338
apex_description: A high-grain ten-round belt replaces the box feed and locks the APOC-338 to semi-auto, trading sustained volume for a lighter profile and heavier impact on every round. Blocks Magazine Attachment.
description: Chambered in powerful .338 rounds, the belt-fed APOC-338 delivers devastating firepower at the cost of a slower cyclic rate and punishing recoil.

name: MAR-9
apex_description: Introducing the fully automatic MAR-9 Auto from Bruen. Boasting a high fire rate, this powerhouse provides a significant increase in stopping power over its semi-automatic counterpart. Blocks Trigger Action Attachment.
description: A well-rounded DMR chambered in 7.62, the semi-automatic MAR- 9 delivers high-power precision and moderate, controllable recoil. Effective at medium to long range, this tactical rifle is ideal for operators who take a methodical approach.

name: Oris 8.6
apex_description: A compact blade module mounted to the receiver, housing up to three quick access throwing knives for close-range, low-signature engagements. Designed as a reliable fall back when stealth or conservation of fire matters most. Blocks Underbarrel Attachments.
description: A lightweight bolt-action rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, the Oris 8.6 delivers impressive energy from a compact, modular frame. Sleek monolithic design and smooth cycling make it effective for precision fire in tight or mobile engagements. Subsonic rounds hide enemy skulls on kills.

name: Mosin-Nagant
apex_description: For a bladed advantage, outfit the Mosin-Nagant with an advanced ballistic bayonet. In addition to improving melee lunge range, the spring-loaded bayonet can be launched at enemies and retrieved for repeat use. Blocks Barrel and Muzzle Attachments.
description: A relic of a bygone era that remains deadly in modern combat. The Mosin-Nagant combines rugged reliability with hard-hitting long-range performance.

name: KG-7 Vulcan
apex_description: Allows for KG-9 Drillcharge rounds to be side-mounted to the rifle. Each projectile drills into a surface before quickly detonating. Ideal for flushing out entrenched combatants.
description: A high-capacity, bolt-action sniper rifle that has seen more combat than most. Its longstanding battlefield experience translates to a higher rate of fire for quickly sending shots downrange.

name: Astaroth .57
apex_description: The Infiltrator combines sonar and radio wave pulses to detect enemies through cover and behind walls. The RF signal’s penetration is limited but offsets valuable recon in the right situation. Magazine capacity reduced to 1. Blocks Optic Attachments.
description: A weapon of immense destructive force, this single-shot behemoth launches devastating 14.5mm rounds at supersonic velocities. One clean hit is all it takes to end the fight.

name: Signal 50
apex_description: Give “weapons hot” a new meaning. This aftermarket modification from XRK loads the Signal 50 with .50 Cal Incendiary Rounds, providing a significant increase to vehicle and Killstreak damage. Blocks Ammunition Attachments.
description: Equipped with a recoil-reducing reciprocating barrel, this devastating .50 Cal anti-2material rifle offers enhanced shot stability and precision, helping operators stay on target when every round counts.

name: SANG 9mm
apex_description: An underbarrel shotgun attachment that loads one 12-gauge shell. Canted weapon stance braces against the 12-gauge recoil. Keep this handy for close encounters. Blocks Laser Attachments.
description: Built for close-quarters engagements, the SANG 9mm delivers rapid follow-up shots, minimal recoil, and dependable 9mm stopping power.

name: Krait P68
apex_description: Held in an icepick grip, this CQB tactical knife is ready for action at a moment's notice. Improves melee damage and melee lunge range. Off-hand stabilizes the weapon for better recoil control.
description: Designed for police and military use, the semi-automatic Krait P68 pairs .45-caliber rounds with controllable fire rate and recoil reliability in the field. Subsonic rounds hide enemy skulls on kills.

name: .50 GS
apex_description: Packaging devastating firepower and a thunderous rate of fire, this fully automatic .50 GS turns every trigger pull into a show of force. Warning: Not intended for accuracy. Blocks Trigger Action Attachments.
description: A powerhouse in any operator's hands, this 50-caliber sidearm is a heavy-hitter when the recoil is controlled.

name: Mojave .357
apex_description: Fan the hammer to fire in quick succession from the hip, laying down rapid shots that favor speed over precision. Blocks Trigger Action Attachments.
description: Chambered in .357, this timeless revolver delivers devastating stopping power at close range.

name: PILA
description: A lightweight, portable air-defense system, the PILA can deploy both guided and unguided missiles as needed. Missiles fired require an 11-meter activation distance but are tuned to detonate on contact with vehicles at any range.

name: RPG-8
description: A man-portable, anti-vehicle launcher that fires unguided, rocket-propelled grenades. Missile activates at 9 meters but will detonate on contact with vehicles at any range.

name: JOKR
description: Lock on, fire, and relocate. The JOKR launches a high-explosive payload that strikes enemy vehicles from above where armor is weakest.

name: PM-40 Anvil
description: Built for area denial and room-clearing, this pump-action 43mm grenade launcher hits hard at close and medium range.

name: FSS Carbon Edge 1095
description: Made of 1095 carbon steel, this dagger-blade combat knife is a fast, quiet, and lethal CQB option.
